Hi Sam — welcome, and thanks for the questions. Short version up front: portal preferred, email fallback accepted with a routing token. Details below plus a lightweight checklist.

Preferred path (fastest, best data quality):
- Supplier portal upload (preferred): https://vendor.redwood.com/portal
- Upload a single PDF per invoice, or a ZIP if multiple invoices. Portal validates fields and returns an acknowledgement.

Fallback path (email):
- Address: invoices@redwood.com (monitored by ingestion pipeline)
- Required subject token: [RW-INVOICE] at the start of the subject line (e.g., "[RW-INVOICE] Invoice 2026-4321")
- If the token is missing we'll try heuristic routing but that adds manual triage delay.

Minimum required invoice fields (for automated intake):
- Vendor name (exact)
- Redwood PO number (if applicable) OR a clear "No PO" indicator
- Invoice number
- Invoice date (ISO format preferred)
- Line-item description, quantity, unit price, line total
- Invoice currency and invoice total

Optional but strongly recommended:
- Tax amount and tax registration number (if applicable)
- GL code or department code (helps downstream coding; we can map after onboarding)

Attachment and filename guidance:
- Preferred: PDF (searchable). XLSX allowed if you need structured rows.
- Filename pattern: ACME_INV_YYYYMMDD_# (helps manual lookup)

Onboarding artifacts attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (please fill & return), invoice_template_v2.xlsx (sample column mapping).

Operational notes:
- If you will be receiving POs, we will stamp the PO onto the invoice during processing — but we need the PO number present on the invoice for an automated match.
- Average time to full portal activation after completed form: 1–3 business days.
- If you need SFTP drop, call me and we can evaluate; otherwise portal/email cover 95% of cases.

Next steps for you:
1) Complete vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and return to invoices@redwood.com.
2) Send one sample invoice (PDF or XLSX) using the subject token if emailing.
3) We'll confirm mapping and flip the portal access switch.

Attachments: invoice_template_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 26 KB), vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

Thanks,

Hi Sam — thanks for returning the forms and sample invoice. Quick answers and next steps from Finance Ops: 

1) PO stamping: we require the PO number to be present on the invoice for automated matching. If the PO number is present we do not need a separate field — the processing engine will match on the PO string. If a PO is absent, mark the invoice with "No PO" and it will route to coding for manual approval.

2) GL codes: optional. If you can include a GL/department column it speeds coding but it's not mandatory for go-live. We can map your GLs to our chart of accounts during the onboarding window.

3) Go-live timeline: once we receive the completed onboarding form and a sample (which you sent), we will:
   - Configure your portal account / ingestion mapping (1 business day)
   - Run a validation invoice and confirm acceptance (same day)
   - Move production toggles on (within 1–3 business days total)

4) Acceptance criteria for emailed fallback: subject must include [RW-INVOICE], attachments must be PDF or XLSX, and filename should include vendor name and invoice date.
